passage: Many people picture glaciers as frozen and motionless. In fact, glaciers flow slowly downhill under their own enormous weight, and some move more than a meter each day. As they creep forward, they grind against the rock beneath them, carving deep valleys over thousands of years.
stem: Which choice best states the main purpose of the text?
choices: To correct a common misconception about glaciers and describe one effect of their movement
To argue that glaciers around the world are melting faster today than at any other time in Earth's long history
To explain how scientists measure the speed at which different glaciers move downhill
To compare the valleys carved by glaciers with the valleys carved by flowing rivers
steps: Sentence 1: a common belief (glaciers don't move).
"In fact" corrects it: glaciers flow downhill.
The last sentence describes an effect: carving valleys.
Melting rates, measurement methods and rivers are not discussed.
key: "In fact" after a common belief usually signals a correction.
